response.rationale: Both entries correctly express the physical sense “not deep.” “Dangkal” is a standard Indonesian choice, while “cetek” is a standard Malaysian Malay choice; the forms also overlap regionally, so the contrast is a preference distinction rather than an exclusive equivalence. No false-friend issue is present.
